result.title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
result.summary: This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice. The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols. Empirical validation across the MGSM and MMLU benchmarks demonstrates that GuideEvolve attains performance metrics comparable to current state-of-the-art models (89.8% accuracy versus Gödel Agent's 90.6% on MGSM; 89.1% versus 87.9% on MMLU), while exhibiting notably reduced variance (25-59%) and enhanced robustness. Furthermore, the framework achieves a 100% evolution success rate, superior to the baseline's 82%, diminishes required optimization iterations by approximately 50% (from 30 iterations in baseline to 15.1 and 13.4 across tasks), and provides improved stability for production deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GuideEvolve 自演化 Agent 框架，结合任务特定专家评估驱动的演化流程与「快慢思考、回退（Throwback）、自主终止」三种自主调控机制，在 MGSM 与 MMLU 上验证准确率、方差与演化迭代效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自主终止」与「时间回退」对应 LVR 的停止决策与推理状态回退/更新，可核查这些轨迹层面的调控规则能否迁移到 latent 状态的动态计算与 STOP 判据；但工作为纯文本 Agent 框架，与视觉证据筛选无直接联系。
